steps.name: Blacksteel Intelligence Squad Member
steps.text: ...Two people died during the unrest, four are seriously wounded, dozens more have lighter injuries, thirteen shops and homes were looted, and small fires broke out in parts of main street.

steps.name: Blacksteel Intelligence Squad Member
steps.text: Fortunately, our squads managed to quickly bring the situation under control.

steps.name: Blacksteel Intelligence Squad Member
steps.text: Currently, we have mercenary teams stationed in the plate's most important facilities and main roads, to maintain public security and order.

steps.name: Blacksteel Intelligence Squad Member
steps.text: Should I stop my report?

steps.name: 'Clip' Cliff
steps.text: Let's pause here for now.

steps.name: Blacksteel Intelligence Squad Member
steps.text: Then if you'll excuse me. I'll come back in once you're done with your call.

steps.name: 'Clip' Cliff
steps.text: No need. You can listen in.

steps.name: Bank President
steps.text: Apologies for calling this late, Mr. Cliff. We've put the reserve funds in storage, and I'd like to thank everyone for escorting them all this way.

steps.name: 'Clip' Cliff
steps.text: No need to thank us for fulfilling our contract. Also, I'd rather discuss what comes next—the towing—in person.

steps.name: Bank President
steps.text: When will you be free? Tomorrow at noon?

steps.name: 'Clip' Cliff
steps.text: Sure, I'll have my secretary arrange it.

steps.name: Bank President
steps.text: I'd also like to ask another question, if you don't mind.

steps.name: 'Clip' Cliff
steps.text: Go ahead.

steps.name: Bank President
steps.text: I'm wondering... how do you plan to handle the townsfolk who participated in last night's unrest?

steps.name: 'Clip' Cliff
steps.text: We've detained the ones we caught on the landship for the time being, and we're currently tracking down the rest.

steps.name: Bank President
steps.text: Tsk... Those thugs were already giving us a headache. They're in dire straits financially, and now they've turned to robbing others.

steps.name: 'Clip' Cliff
steps.text: You sound pretty familiar with them.

steps.name: Bank President
steps.text: Yes, they're all old acquaintances on the bank's debtor list.

steps.name: 'Clip' Cliff
steps.text: Mind if we take a look at that?

steps.name: Bank President
steps.text: Of course not. If you're going to look into the matter, you should start with these people.

steps.name: Helena
steps.text: Thanks for bringing him over last night, Jessica.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: Is Leone alright? Benny's gone, and then his house, the only thing he had left, burned down in that fire. He...

steps.name: Helena
steps.text: He didn't say anything... Fell asleep as soon as I treated his wounds.

steps.name: Woodrow
steps.text: He's lucky he spends his nights getting wasted on the streets instead of sleeping in bed.

steps.name: Helena
steps.text: That's enough out of you, Woody.

steps.name: Helena
steps.text: Fine, I'll go check on him.

steps.name: Woodrow
steps.text: Jessica... weren't you outside welcoming the landship yesterday? Why'd you come back all of a sudden?

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: Actually, Woodrow... I was looking for you, but I saw smoke coming from Leone's house, so I went there first.

steps.name: Woodrow
steps.text: For me? What for?

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: Ever since I got here... I've been worrying nonstop about the landship's arrival.

steps.name: Woodrow
steps.text: But that's your company. Ain't it a good thing? Now you've got an entire fortress of your buddies to take over any problems y'all have been facing.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: But... that doesn't mean Blacksteel being here will be good for the people of the plate.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: Nomadic platforms are expensive to build and an extremely scarce resource, so the government won't just discard them. They'll probably refurbish the plate, upgrading it and integrating it into a larger settlement.

steps.name: Woodrow
steps.text: Still not seeing the downside.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: But they don't want the residents to stay, so they're doing everything they can to make them leave on their own...

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: That's why the bank's here.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: They've recovered a lot of the fallen platform's assets through loan contracts and risky ventures, and they've sent a lot of people to the frontier too.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: Methods like these are perfectly legal... there's nothing for us to object to.

steps.name: Woodrow
steps.text: Are the people really gonna take it though?

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: Maybe they don't have a choice...? You've been here a lot longer than I have, so I'm sure you know better than I do.

steps.name: Woodrow
steps.text: Heh, we still have a few tough nuts to crack.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: ...Which is why they've engaged a mercenary group like Blacksteel.

steps.name: Bank President
steps.text: And what about after your undoubtedly thorough investigation? Do you plan to keep the detainees at Fort Barron?

steps.name: 'Clip' Cliff
steps.text: I may as well ask how you've dealt with them in the past.

steps.name: Bank President
steps.text: We used to ship guys like them off to the frontier, when we still had police.

steps.name: 'Clip' Cliff
steps.text: Then we'll do the same.

steps.name: Bank President
steps.text: Thank you for doing all this for us.

steps.name: 'Clip' Cliff
steps.text: It's no big deal. Looking forward to our meeting tomorrow.

steps.name: Bank President
steps.text: Hold on. Could I make a small request? Could we have additional security deployed at the bank?

steps.name: 'Clip' Cliff
steps.text: No problem. I'll have my subordinates make any further arrangements.

steps.name: Bank President
steps.text: Right. See you tomorrow then.

steps.name: 'Clip' Cliff
steps.text: What do you think, Tila?

steps.name: Blacksteel Intelligence Squad Member
steps.text: That we're getting our hands dirty again.

steps.name: 'Clip' Cliff
steps.text: What else can they do? They're all respectable people who can't sully their reputations. So it's up to us mercs to be the bad guys.

steps.name: Blacksteel Intelligence Squad Member
steps.text: So how should we handle that last request from the bank?

steps.name: 'Clip' Cliff
steps.text: Did they suffer any damage last night?

steps.name: Blacksteel Intelligence Squad Member
steps.text: Just some obscene graffiti scrawled all over the building.

steps.name: 'Clip' Cliff
steps.text: Whatever... Emotional damage counts as damage too. Just dispatch some people familiar with the situation.

steps.name: 'Clip' Cliff
steps.text: The important thing for now is to figure out how to clear all these irrelevants off the board before the plate starts moving.

steps.name: Woodrow
steps.text: So... your landship ain't here just to tow the plate away, is it?

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: Helping the bank evict debtors and recover non-performing assets are both on the to-do list.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: As for the methods... I don't think they'll leave any room for concessions.

steps.name: Woodrow
steps.text: ...And what do you want me to do about it?

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: Before I came here, someone asked me to bring a bullet to you.

steps.name: Woodrow
steps.text: A bullet?

steps.name: Woodrow
steps.text: ...Who?

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: My boss, 'Clip' Cliff.

steps.name: Woodrow
steps.text: And who's that?

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: When I was looking for you that day, there was an open drawer with a photo inside. Cliff is the man who had his arm around your shoulder.

steps.name: Woodrow
steps.text: ...So he changed his name. Huh. And now he's your boss.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: I'm so sorry, I didn't mean to look.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: But if you have a history with each other, then maybe you could have a word with him? I don't know...

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: If there's anyone he'd listen to, it's you, right? I really don't have any other ideas...

steps.name: Woodrow
steps.text: Jessica, I appreciate you helping out Leone, Helena, and who knows who else. But I just can't wrap my head around why you're being so stubborn about this.

steps.name: Woodrow
steps.text: You're a merc. You've got no duty to us. You don't have to stick your nose into every little thing you see.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: Back in Victoria, I... sat back and just let things happen. And it ended horribly...

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: It was all my fault.

steps.name: Woodrow
steps.text: Thanks for bringing me the bullet. I've been looking for it for a long, long time now.

steps.name: Woodrow
steps.text: You should get back to your friends first. Some things, all I can do is give it my best shot.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: But...

steps.name: Helena
steps.text: Woody—!

steps.name: Helena
steps.text: The bed's empty, Woody! Did Leone go out?

steps.name: Woodrow
steps.text: I ran into him this morning. He's off looking for Miles.

steps.name: Helena
steps.text: Then why didn't you tell me earlier—

steps.name: Woodrow
steps.text: Let's just say... I forgot.

steps.name: Leone
steps.text: Come again?

steps.name: Blacksteel Mercenary
steps.text: My apologies, sir, but this place has been sealed off and no one's allowed in or out.

steps.name: Leone
steps.text: What do you mean no one's allowed in or out? I spent half my life here! Let me through!

steps.name: Blacksteel Mercenary
steps.text: I'm sorry, sir.

steps.name: Leone
steps.text: Hey, wait—what are you doing to me?

steps.name: Leone
steps.text: This...

steps.name: Blacksteel Mercenary
steps.text: Please forgive me, sir. But this is my job.

steps.name: Leone
steps.text: Get your ass back here—

steps.name: Miles
steps.text: Leone?

steps.name: Leone
steps.text: Miles? I was just about to go in there looking for you! You alright after that huge mess last night?

steps.name: Miles
steps.text: I'm good, but... what's with the huge wound on your head?

steps.name: Leone
steps.text: I ran into that gang of troublemakers yesterday, and... we exchanged a few blows. Why aren't you in the tower?

steps.name: Miles
steps.text: Those people barged in here after things quieted down. Said Blacksteel would be taking over the maintenance work and 'kindly escorted' me out.

steps.name: Leone
steps.text: They do anything to you?

steps.name: Miles
steps.text: (Glances at the mercenary standing guard) No...

steps.name: Miles
steps.text: Let's get out of here first. Not exactly the best place to talk.

steps.name: Miles
steps.text: Leave the door open, Leone. We have to get back to the plant later.

steps.name: Leone
steps.text: How can anyone get in there with their eyes all over the place?

steps.name: Miles
steps.text: I know an abandoned path into the tower, hasn't been used in years.

steps.name: Leone
steps.text: Then let's get going.

steps.name: Miles
steps.text: What's the rush? I need to fetch some tools to clear the road, among other things...

steps.name: Leone
steps.text: Need any help?

steps.name: Miles
steps.text: Don't bother, I got everything here. Let's go.

steps.name: Leone
steps.text: *cough* *cough*

steps.name: Leone
steps.text: There's so much dust here. Just how long has this path been here?

steps.name: Miles
steps.text: Has to be at least thirty years since anyone last came through here... *cough* *cough*

steps.name: Laura
steps.text: Who's there? You already called me over, there's no need to send an escort—

steps.name: Laura
steps.text: Huh, Miles and Leone? What are you guys doing here? How'd you get them to let you in?

steps.name: Miles
steps.text: Shh. Keep it down, Laura. We just wanna take a look around. Won't be long.

steps.name: Laura
steps.text: Fine... I'll let you know if the patrol comes around, but keep it quick.

steps.name: Leone
steps.text: ...Lucky we ran into her, and not anyone else.

steps.name: Miles
steps.text: *sigh*

steps.name: Leone
steps.text: What are you doing? There's already fuel in there, so why throw in more stuff to burn?

steps.name: Miles
steps.text: Remember what happened in July? So many people finally caved in and signed agreements to go to the frontier.

steps.name: Leone
steps.text: ...How could I forget?

steps.name: Miles
steps.text: Well, the bank's been putting on the pressure again, and this time there's even more people talking about it.

steps.name: Miles
steps.text: I asked a few families and some of 'em are already waiting for the frontier convoys. Others still want to hold out here, but... how long can they keep it up?

steps.name: Leone
steps.text: Just get to the point, Miles.

steps.name: Miles
steps.text: ...I'm planning to leave too. No one needs the Davistown mine no more. Even if they fix up the plate, no one's gonna care about us miners. Without jobs, we'll all end up leaving in disgrace anyhow.

steps.name: Miles
steps.text: So, y'know... Come with me, Leone.

steps.name: Leone
steps.text: Maybe you're right, but I still ain't leaving.

steps.name: Miles
steps.text: ...Yup, that's the Leone I know.

steps.name: Leone
steps.text: So is that why you wanted to come here? Just to tell me that?

steps.name: Miles
steps.text: No, I came because I wanted to... burn what needs burning, I guess. Before I leave.

steps.name: Leone
steps.text: Wait, but there's so many photos of people in that album. You plan on burning all those too?

steps.name: Miles
steps.text: I ain't like you, Leone. I don't wanna spend the rest of my life here.

steps.name: Leone
steps.text: I figured you were just dead-drunk when you said that last time...

steps.name: Miles
steps.text: I had a notion of leaving this town even when I was young, but no way my parents could take care of all my younger siblings on their own. That's how I ended up stumbling into the mines in a stupor when I was fifteen.

steps.name: Miles
steps.text: My eyes were scorched by the heat and sweat of the boiler room, while the older guys bossed me around. I hated every goddamn minute of it, but could only press on through clenched teeth while thinking about my family.

steps.name: Miles
steps.text: And by the time I realized it, all I knew was taking care of the furnace. Didn't know any other way to live.

steps.name: Leone
steps.text: You never told me all this...

steps.name: Miles
steps.text: Leone. It hurt when Benny said he was leaving, but even then I felt he made the right choice.

steps.name: Leone
steps.text: So this has been a long time coming?

steps.name: Miles
steps.text: Yeah. Let him go before this plate ties him down. Maybe he can go to college. Ironforge City, Trimounts... anywhere's fine as long as it ain't here.

steps.name: Leone
steps.text: So you're saying I should be glad he got out in time?

steps.name: Miles
steps.text: This land here's been squeezed dry, Leone. And those guys from the government are just gonna abandon it entirely, or scoop in new soil from elsewhere...

steps.name: Miles
steps.text: To them, we're just old straw refusing to rot away. Nothing but trouble.

steps.name: Leone
steps.text: ...Wait, what's that?

steps.name: Miles
steps.text: Why's there a photo of your family in there—
Leone reflexively moves to stick his hand into the furnace, but the photo vanishes in a puff of blue smoke before he can even feel the heat.

steps.name: Miles
steps.text: Benny must've left that one in. I wasn't too careful when packing it all up, sorry.

steps.name: Leone
steps.text: It's fine. Don't know why I wanted to grab it in the first place. Wonder how long it'll take these blisters to heal without treatment or medicine.
The flames in the furnace blaze brightly, and a few sparks sputter from within. They cool in the air and turn into smattering specks of gray, falling onto the man's shoes.
He sighs as he rubs the corners of his eyes, only to realize that the wetness that had been there has already dried up from the high temperature.

steps.name: Anxious Resident
steps.text: Sir, this must be a misunderstanding. I stayed home all night yesterday!

steps.name: Blacksteel Mercenary
steps.text: Please cooperate with us, ma'am.

steps.name: Anxious Resident
steps.text: Sir, please! Can't you talk your superiors into being a little flexible? How can I leave for the frontier mid-winter with a child in tow?!

steps.name: Blacksteel Mercenary
steps.text: It seems you do know where we're taking you. So please, just cooperate. We don't want to have to resort to force.

steps.name: Anxious Resident
steps.text: Nooo—!

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: Hey! What are you doing?!

steps.name: Blacksteel Mercenary
steps.text: And which squad are you from?

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: Jessica, Department of Equipment and Applied Technologies. Temporarily transferred to B.P.R.S's Liskarm Squad.

steps.name: Blacksteel Mercenary
steps.text: Oh, so you're that little princess I've heard so much about. An honor to meet you.

spans.text: little princess I've heard so much about. An honor to meet you.

steps.name: Blacksteel Mercenary
steps.text: We're under orders to trace the source of last night's unrest. Locals with heavy debt are our prime suspects, so that's where we're starting our investigation.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: Does your list include a single mom with a child too?

steps.name: Blacksteel Mercenary
steps.text: Just following orders. Besides, even if she's innocent we still have to repossess her mortgaged property.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: Repossess mortgaged property... So this is why the boss had that word with me?

steps.name: Blacksteel Mercenary
steps.text: Listen, I don't see what the boss has to do with this, but I do know you're hindering my work here.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: Don't you realize that you're doing the exact same thing as those gangsters you arrested?!

steps.name: Blacksteel Mercenary
steps.text: Orders, princess. Just following orders. Don't make me repeat myself.

steps.name: Blacksteel Mercenary
steps.text: Reporting. I've found the woman.

steps.name: Anxious Resident
steps.text: Sir... Please, I'm begging you...

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: Let that lady go!

steps.name: Blacksteel Mercenary
steps.text: What?

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: I—I said, let her go.

steps.name: Blacksteel Mercenary
steps.text: We're not the same as you, princess. We need these paychecks to eat.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: Paychecks... paychecks!

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: Is your paycheck—No, no! I mean, I'm saying...

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: I... I can pay you!

steps.name: Blacksteel Mercenary
steps.text: What's this now? Bribery? Raythean's little lady is actually trying to bribe me?

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: Yes, I'm just a stupid little rich girl who throws money at all her problems, okay?!

steps.name: Blacksteel Mercenary
steps.text: Guess there's no need for professional integrity when you've got a family like that at your back. But me? I can only trade my conscience for cash at Blacksteel.

steps.name: Blacksteel Mercenary
steps.text: I'm glad you're so self aware, but it really doesn't matter. Just stop making things difficult for us lowly peasants.

steps.name: Blacksteel Mercenary
steps.text: If you've got money to burn, why not head on over to the bank and pay off all their debts?

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: You—

steps.name: Blacksteel Mercenary
steps.text: Easy there, princess. Take your finger off the trigger, yeah? I know you lost your head for a bit there, but we still have to act according to our stations.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: Wh-What?
Jessica lowers her head to find that at some point, her hand had moved to her holster.
When she sees what is probably an expression of both wariness and disdain on the mercenary's face, she ends up swallowing her apology as she turns around and runs towards the bank.
